```{r}
system2("fastqc", "SRR6805880.tiny.fastq.gz")
```
```{r}
fastq_files <- list.files(
  pattern = "^SRR680588.*\\.tiny\\.fastq\\.gz$"
)

for (f in fastq_files) {
  base <- sub("\\.tiny\\.fastq\\.gz$", "", f)

  output <- paste0(base, ".tiny_trimmed.fastq.gz")

  system2("cutadapt", args = c(
    "-g", "TGCAG",
    "-o", output,
    f
  ))
}
```
```{r}
system2("bowtie2-build", c(
  "Ppar_tinygenome.fna",
  "Ppar_tinygenome"
))
```
```{r}
trimmed_files <- list.files(
  pattern = "^SRR680588.*\\.tiny_trimmed\\.fastq\\.gz$"
)

for (f in trimmed_files) {
  base <- sub("\\.tiny_trimmed\\.fastq\\.gz$", "", f)
  output <- paste0(base, ".sam")

  cat("Mapping sample:", base, "\n")

  system2("bowtie2", args = c(
    "-x", "Ppar_tinygenome",
    "-U", f,
    "-S", output
  ))
}
```
```{r}
sam_files <- list.files(pattern = "^SRR680588.*\\.sam$")
length(sam_files)
sam_files
```
```{r}
sam_files <- list.files(pattern = "^SRR680588.*\\.sam$")

for (f in sam_files) {
  base <- sub("\\.sam$", "", f)
  output <- paste0(base, ".bam")

  cat("Converting:", f, "\n")

  system(
    paste(
      shQuote(Sys.which("samtools")),
      "view -bh",
      shQuote(f),
      "|",
      shQuote(Sys.which("samtools")),
      "sort -o",
      shQuote(output),
      "-"
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
angsd_path <- path.expand("~/angsd/angsd")

system2(angsd_path, args = c(
  "-bam", "bam.filelist",
  "-GL", "1",
  "-out", "genotype_likelihoods",
  "-doMaf", "2",
  "-SNP_pval", "1e-2",
  "-doMajorMinor", "1"
))
```
